samples.summary: Now that `buildProgram()` is exported from `src/cli.ts`, the hand-rolled registration helpers in the test suite duplicate it and can drift from the shipped wiring. `test/namespaces.test.ts:10` re-registers docs/sheets/slides/notes/api-keys itself (and omits login/logout/status/ctx/schema), and `test/output.test.ts:233` defines a second local `buildProgram` that shadows the newly imported one in the same file. The delta creates the canonical helper but does not fold the pre-existing duplicates into it, so 'the program the tests exercise' and 'the program the binary ships' remain separate definitions.

`runCli(program = buildProgram(), argv?)` exposes two production-unused parameters purely as test seams; nothing in the shipped path (`bin.ts:6` calls `runCli()`) ever passes either. A narrower fit would be to export `buildProgram()` and a `runProgram(program, argv)` used by both, rather than defaulting the injected program inside the entrypoint (which also puts construction outside the try/catch). This is an approach/taste point, not a missed requirement.
